item.title: HashiCorp
item.description: HashiCorp is a technology company specializing in infrastructure automation for cloud environments. Their suite of open-source tools, such as Terraform, Vault, Consul, and Packer, enables organizations to provision, secure, connect, and run infrastructure efficiently. HashiCorp’s solutions support multi-cloud and hybrid cloud strategies, helping teams manage infrastructure as code and automate workflows.
